I can’t reliably calculate this many sequential updates by hand. This Python snippet will evaluate the assignments exactly; paste the full assignment sequence into `s`:

```python
import re

s = """PASTE THE ASSIGNMENTS HERE"""

values = {}
pattern = r'(\w+)\s*<-\s*(\d+|\(\s*(\w+)\s*\+\s*(\d+)\s*\)\s*mod\s*100)'

for name, expression, _, increment in re.findall(pattern, s):
    if increment:
        values[name] = (values[name] + int(increment)) % 100
    else:
        values[name] = int(expression)

print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in
                ("a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h", "TMP")))
```
